headline: Russia has become the world record holder for the number of sanctions imposed against it — Putin
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin said Russia has become the world leader in the number of restrictive measures imposed against it, speaking at a business forum.
why: Western sanctions restrict Russian trade, finance and energy exports, and they shape the investment and currency outlook for Russian assets.
original_headline: Россия стала мировым рекордсменом по числу введенных против нее санкций — Путин
